'''Haman son of [[Dal]] son of [[Morel]]''' is an [[Elder]] of [[Stedding Shangtai|''Stedding'' Shangtai]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is tall and white-haired with drooping, white mustaches and a long narrow beard that hung to his chest.{{Ref/book|11|19}} He is around 10'5" or 318&nbsp;cm tall with a broad build. He has eyes as large and round as teacups, a broad nose that almost covered his face and ears, tipped with white tufts, which stuck up through his hair.{{Ref/book|6|20}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Haman son of Dal son of Morel|Haman}} His voice is like rumbling thunder and grave in tone.{{Ref/book|6|20}}

==History==
Haman was born well over three hundred years ago.{{Ref/book|11|19}} His father is [[Dal]] and his grandfather was [[Morel]].{{Ref/book|6|20}}

When he as young, Haman and [[Loial]]'s father met the Green Man.{{ref/book|1|46}} He is more accostumed to being Outside than any Ogier save the stonemasons.{{Ref/book|11|20}}

He is married to [[Voniel]], [[Covril]]'s sister, making him Loial's uncle.{{ref||Haman}}

He is one of the Council of Elders of ''Stedding'' Shangtai.{{ref||Haman}}

Haman was Loial's teacher and he did not think highly of Loial's scholarship and study habits.{{ref||Haman}} He also thinks Loial is much too hasty and has no sense at all.{{Ref/book|1|43}} Besides Loial, he has other classes and pupils.{{Ref/book|6|20}}

Haman thinks Cairhienin see plots in everything and that [[Galldrian Riatin]] was a disgrace.{{Ref/book|2|30}}{{Ref/book|2|25}}

== Activities ==
He walks from his ''stedding'' when he is "persuaded" by [[Covril]] to go with her in the search for [[Loial]]. They stop in [[Caemlyn]] where [[Rand al'Thor]] tells them that he is now in the [[Two Rivers]]. After helping Rand find all the [[Waygate]]s on a map, goes with him to [[Shadar Logoth]] in which he helps Rand find the Waygate there. Rand then takes them via a Gateway to just outside [[Emond's Field]].{{Ref/book|6|20}}

He finally found Loial at [[Algarin Pendaloan]]'s mansion in [[Tear]]. There he wed Loial and [[Erith]] in a private ceremony.{{Ref/book|11|19}} Immediately after the wedding, there was an attack by [[Trollocs]], and it is implied that he might have participated in the battle.
He then sets off and leaves Loial to talk at the [[Great Stump]], while he sets off to seal all the other [[Waygate]]s [[Rand al'Thor]] hasn't managed to do yet.{{Ref/book|11|20}}

Haman and his people at the conclusion of the Great Stump arrive at the [[Field of Merrilor]]. There they are greeted by [[Great Tree]]s that Rand grew during his signing of the [[Dragon's Peace]]. The Ogier pledge their support to fight with humans at [[Tarmon Gai'don]].{{Ref/book|14|7}} Haman and the rest of the Ogier fight with Queen [[Elayne Trakand]]'s army in the Last Battle. There, the Ogier sing a terrifying death song, hacking fiercely at Trollocs around them. The Trollocs begin to fear the sight of the Ogier.{{Ref/book|14|16}}{{Ref/book|14|32}}
